title: CLI-BRK-01: Prevent time arithmetic overflow in CLI reports
description:
## Related files
- src/domain/mod.rs (parse_time, parse_line, TimeEntry.minutes)
- src/domain/reporting.rs (TrackedTime aggregation, sum helpers)

## Description
Large time values can overflow during parsing or aggregation. Examples include oversized time tokens, multiplication by h/p, or cumulative totals across entries. This can crash debug builds or silently corrupt totals in release builds.

## Acceptance criteria
- Time multiplication uses checked arithmetic
- Per-entry accumulation uses checked arithmetic
- Report total aggregation handles overflow explicitly
- User gets a clear error/warning instead of wrapped totals
- Tests cover: oversized token like 71582789h, cumulative overflow within one line, cumulative overflow across multiple entries

title: CLI-BRK-03: Reset parser state after invalid TT date headers
description:
## Related files
- src/parsing/model.rs (LineType::parse, try_parse_to_header)
- src/parsing/parser.rs (process_line_mut, state.current_date)
- src/parsing/header_parser.rs (maybe_date_from_header)
- tests/acceptance/general.rs (error_reporting module)

## Description
Invalid ## TT <date> headers currently produce a warning, but parser state may continue using the previous valid current_date. Entries after the invalid header can be attributed to the wrong day.

## Acceptance criteria
- Invalid TT date headers clear or suspend the active tracking date
- Entries following an invalid TT header are not assigned to the previous valid date
- Parsing resumes correctly when a later valid TT header appears
- Acceptance test proves no misattribution after: valid TT header, invalid TT header, entry, later valid TT header

title: CLI-BRK-04: Make directory processing resilient to unreadable or skipped files
description:
## Related files
- src/parsing/processor.rs (DirectoryProcessor::process, SingleFileProcessor::read_file_content, filter_map(Result::ok), .max_depth(10))
- src/parsing/mod.rs (parse_entries_from_path, tracking_result)
- tests/acceptance/general.rs (directory_processing module)

## Description
Directory mode mixes hard failure and silent data loss. One unreadable supported file can abort the whole report, while traversal errors are silently dropped. The fixed behaviour should be deliberate: report inaccessible files and keep processing readable files where possible.

## Acceptance criteria
- Directory traversal errors are surfaced as warnings
- Per-file read errors in directory mode do not discard all valid readable data
- Single-file mode can still fail hard for unreadable input
- Warning includes enough path context to identify the failed file
- Tests cover: readable + unreadable supported file, traversal/read error does not suppress valid entries, unsupported files remain ignored

title: CLI-BRK-06: Reject invalid CLI filters and empty tag/project values
description:
## Related files
- src/cli/mod.rs (Args::validate, context_filter, exclude_tags, breakdown_unit)
- src/domain/tags.rs (Tag::from_raw, TagFilter::parse)
- src/domain/mod.rs (parse_line, missing project validation)
- tests/acceptance/details.rs, tests/acceptance/tags.rs, tests/acceptance/breakdown.rs

## Description
Several invalid CLI/domain inputs are accepted or silently ignored. Invalid --breakdown values fall back to normal report output. Empty project/tag values can create confusing filters or empty project names, including #prj-.

## Acceptance criteria
- Invalid --breakdown value fails with a clear CLI error
- Empty --project is rejected
- Empty --tags / comma-only tag filters are handled deliberately
- Empty --exclude-tags values are ignored or rejected consistently
- #prj- is rejected as a missing/invalid project
- Tests cover invalid and valid inputs for all above cases

title: Reject invalid web period query parameters
description: Web handlers currently ignore invalid period values and continue with unfiltered data. Change dashboard/outcomes/tag/chart endpoints to reject invalid period query  parameters with a 400 response and clear error message. Keep valid period behaviour unchanged and add web acceptance tests.

title: Evaluate vendoring web frontend assets
description: Assess whether HTMX, Chart.js, and Pico CSS should be vendored or served locally instead of loaded from CDNs. Consider offline development, reproducible builds, supply-chain risk, cache behaviour, and maintenance cost. Produce a recommendation before implementation.
